Wanting something badly can be the very thing that blocks it.

Kevin Trudeau says the missing key to manifesting is not being attached to a particular outcome. If you feel the lack of something, you keep focusing on the fact that you do not have it.

Letting go of that attachment frees you. That is why he calls the journey the reward, and says success is the progressive realization of a worthwhile goal.

What goal are you gripping so tightly it is stealing your peace?

#ad #success #goals #kevintrudeau

The popular line about leaders is only half true.

Kevin Trudeau says the saying that leaders are not born, they are made, is a myth. Look at any first-grade class and you can spot natural leaders. He says it is in their DNA.

He adds that we also learn through our environment. The two are not mutually exclusive: it is both.

What did you inherit, and what did you have to learn?

#ad #success #mindset #kevintrudeau

Most success books skip the part that actually keeps people motivated.

Kevin Trudeau says the real driver, the why behind the why, is missing from the books he has read. He traveled with many well-known motivational speakers and says they were well-meaning.

In his view, some of them taught courses on becoming successful before they had built big businesses themselves. He says knowing about success is different from knowing it.

When did you last weigh advice by whether the person had actually done it?
